Approach Pack 28

Twenty-eight litres, one main compartment, and a lid that comes off when you do not want it. We left out the side pockets, the hydration sleeve and the daisy chains because every one of them is something that can tear.

The back panel is a single foam sheet rather than a frame, so the pack carries well up to about twelve kilos and badly above it. For a full winter load you want something else.

165 USD. Black or moss.
